summary: Frontend-only end-to-end regression of Ready2UP Sales Command Center (/ready2up.html) after the full redesign. Exercised all data-testids listed in the review request across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): header, hero, stat cards, sprint tracker, filters, pills, sorting, follow-up notes, stage change, daily WhatsApp report, playbook modal, lead card actions, CSV export, mobile dock. All 12 functional groups PASSED with no console errors, no page errors, and zero emoji characters in body / scripts.
critical_code_review_comments: ready2up.html is 2172 lines in a single file (CSS + HTML + LEADS + JS). Consider splitting LEADS into a JSON file and JS into separate module for maintainability, though this contradicts the single-file constraint stated in the problem.
Sort selector default option value is 'default' (not 'recommended') — matches the label 'Sort: Recommended' but the internal key differs; not a bug, but worth documenting.

'Hot Opportunities' stat = 40, while LEADS.filter(priority==='HIGH').length = 35. The app defines 'hot' as HIGH-priority OR no-website with strong signals; the number 40 matches the spec but the label may be slightly misleading. Not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage was cleared between scenarios; keys used: r2u_sort_v1, r2u_lead_notes_v1, r2u_daily_calls_v1, r2u_lead_stage_v1 (implied by stage persistence).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full regression suite lives at /tmp/test_r2u.py — reusable. Uses async playwright directly (not the mcp browser tool) to avoid f-string backslash issues. Run with: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/pw-browsers python /tmp/test_r2u.py. Playwright pip package + chromium headless shell were installed in this iteration. Verified: 61 leads, 40 hot, ₹22.0L pipeline, sort persists in r2u_sort_v1, follow-up chips render correctly for past/today/future, pill-due increments correctly, stage 'Deal Won' persists after reload with won-ribbon + is-won class + deals-closed=1, daily report modal builds valid WhatsApp text (share href starts with https://wa.me/?text= and decoded body matches report-text exactly), CSV exports 62 lines with Note + Next Follow-up columns and correct filename Ready2UP_Nashik_Leads_YYYY-MM-DD.csv, mobile dock visible only <=768px, wa-send-btn hidden for universal playbook and phoneless leads, visible for lead 31 (Gandharv Restaurant) with correct wa.me/919881632502 href, no emojis found via regex on body/wa-script/call-script.
